messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Elevated 5xx rate detected on /v1/generate across prod-us-east-1 cluster (p95 latency spike, gateway timeouts). Error budget burn > 12% in the last 5m. Alert: INC-19625. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.example/alerts/INC-19625

alex: seeing rapid increases in 502/504s and a swarm of KV miss logs from prefix-cache service. Paging oncall.

beth_oncall: I'm oncall. Pulling up traces and logs now. Which customer routes are hit?

sam: top impacted routes: chat-stream (highest), text-gen-standard. A subset of requests are returning backend 5xx from inference-proxy. Observed repeated lines: `prefix_cache: miss for key=shard-32:prefix-abc` and `kv-client: connection reset`.

mira: looks like eviction spikes from prefix-cache shards 30-36, high eviction_rate counters. Could be compaction/GC at same time.

alex: logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T18:20:05Z] prefix-cache INFO evicting 2312 entries shard=33 reason=memory_pressure
[2026-03-15T18:20:05Z] prefix-cache WARN thrash_detected shard=33 recent_evictions=1200
[2026-03-15T18:20:06Z] kv-client ERROR rpc failed: code=14, context canceled, shard=33
[2026-03-15T18:20:07Z] inference-proxy ERROR upstream 502 generated_by=prefix-miss
```

beth_oncall: Customer impact? Any high- paying tenants affected?

kim_cs: We see elevated error reports from two enterprise customers (acme-corp, media-forward). Both experiencing timeouts and failed generation jobs. They're in US-EAST primarily. CS is preparing messaging.

mira: hypothesis: eviction storm causing large increase in cold misses -> backend KV paging to remote store causing latency and gateway timeouts. Also some kv-client retries saturating connection pools leading to downstream 502s.

sam: reproduction query against metrics: prefix_cache.evictions_total[5m] by (shard) shows shards 31-35 spike ~2000 evictions/min. kv_client.rpc_latency p99 spikes for same shards.

alex: quick mitigation options: 1) temporarily bypass prefix cache for hot routes; 2) increase kv_client connection pool and circuit breaker thresholds; 3) rollback recent prefix-cache config change (if any); 4) restart affected prefix-cache pods to rehydrate evenly.

beth_oncall: Any recent deploys? eng-releases?

alex: no full deploys within the hour. There was a config tweak to prefix_cache.eviction_watermark yesterday evening but it rolled out gradually — could be related.

mira: I'd like to test bypassing cache for chat-stream route to see if errors drop. We can toggle routing rule feature-flag `routes.chat-stream.prefix_cache=false` in the feature flags service.

beth_oncall: go for it. Prepare rollback plan and make change in staging first.

sam: running staging toggle now...

infra-bot: deploybot: feature-flag update queued by sam for routes.chat-stream.prefix_cache=false (target=prod, rollout=immediate). Tracking id FF-7864

sam: toggled in prod. Watching metrics.

mira: immediate drop in 502s for chat-stream route, p50 latency up ~10ms but p95 improves significantly. Nice.

alex: good signal this is cache-related. But other routes still showing errors. We should prevent eviction storm recurrence. Suggestions?

beth_oncall: Let's scale prefix-cache memory on affected shards and add a short-term rate limiter for KV fetches to reduce thundering-herd load on backing store. Also open support ticket with KV datastore if we see backend errors.

mira: scaling memory: applying pod patch to increase cache_mem_limit from 12GB -> 18GB for shards 30-36. Command:
```
kubectl -n infra patch deployment prefix-cache-33 --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"prefix-cache","env":[{"name":"CACHE_MEM_LIMIT","value":"18432"}] }]}}}}'
```

infra-bot: kubectl apply accepted. Rolling update started for prefix-cache-33..36 (strategy=rolling, maxUnavailable=1).

sam: adding a soft token-bucket limiter on `kv-client` to 200r/s per shard to reduce backing-store amplification. Deploying a small config change.

alex: also seeing occasional `kv-index-corrupt` warnings but unclear if false positives; need to investigate.

mira: log excerpt that looks worrying:
```
[2026-03-15T18:22:14Z] kv-index ERROR checksum mismatch index=prefix_idx_33 expected=0x7b3a got=0x1f2c
[2026-03-15T18:22:14Z] kv-index WARN falling back to remote-paging shard=33
```

beth_oncall: if index corruption is real, we must be cautious with restarts. But first, mitigation is more important to restore customer traffic.

kim_cs: CS updated customers: "We're investigating elevated errors in US-EAST, mitigations in progress. We'll update in 30 minutes."

sam: after scaling and limiter, ingress 5xxs down by ~70% across cluster. Some residual timeouts remain on a small fraction of requests that still hit shards 33/34.

mira: for the potentially corrupted index, propose we mark shard 33 for background reindexing and avoid full restart. There's a `reindex --shard=33 --background` admin endpoint. I'll trigger with low concurrency.

alex: run `curl -XPOST https://admin.redwood.example/shard/reindex -d '{"shard":33,"mode":"background","max_workers":2}'` and watch logs.

mira: running it now. Response: `{ "job_id": "reidx-19625-33", "status": "started" }`

infra-bot: reindex job reidx-19625-33 accepted. ETA ~12m.

beth_oncall: folks, I'll start a short handoff in 10m to second oncall (mira) since I need to drop for another pager. Keep monitoring and update the incident channel.

alex: noted. We should also collect heap/metrics dumps from affected pods for postmortem. I'll kick off trace collection.

sam: trace snapshots uploaded: https://console.redwood.example/traces/INC-19625/snapshots

mira: reindex job progressing, no errors so far. Eviction rate trending down. KV backend 5xx count returned to baseline after limiter.

beth_oncall: handing off to @mira for ongoing mitigation and customer comms. I'm removing myself from active pager at 18:35Z. Handoff comment: default mitigation path = keep feature-flag bypass for chat-stream (until reindex done), keep rate limiter, monitor.

mira: taking over. I'll coordinate with infra to keep scaled memory until reindex finishes and then gradually lower mem limits back to target. Planning to leave `routes.chat-stream.prefix_cache=false` until we validate reindex.

kim_cs: I'll prepare a consolidated update to customers with ETA and note that we have mitigations and are not expecting data loss.

alex: post-mitigation check: run load test for affected routes to validate no regression. Also schedule postmortem.

mira: reindex completed successfully: `reidx-19625-33` status=done. Checksums now match, no further index errors in logs.

infra-bot: prefix-cache-33 rolling update completed. All pods ready. Memory limit will be rolled down in 30m during a quiet window unless we decide otherwise.

mira: beginning gradual rollback of feature-flag for chat-stream in 5m with canary 10%. Will monitor p95 and error rate.

sam: re-enabling cache for 10% traffic now. No spike. Increasing to 50%... stable. Rolling to 100% completed.

mira: metrics stable, 5xx at baseline. Closing immediate incident mitigations.

kim_cs: customer update sent: "Mitigations applied; service restored; we will follow up with a detailed postmortem in 48 hours."

beth_oncall: thanks team. I'll compile handoff notes into the incident ticket and assign postmortem owners (alex + mira + sam).

alex: logs to include in postmortem: eviction spike, reindex job, kv-client saturation, feature-flag bypass results, pod memory scaling.

mira: final note: root cause likely combination of lower-than-expected cache watermark from recent config and a large, correlated upload from a customer causing transient memory pressure and eviction cascade. Action items: 1) revert recent watermark change; 2) add alert for eviction_rate by shard > 500/min; 3) add circuit-breaker to kv-client to fail fast earlier; 4) run chaos test for cache eviction scenarios.

kim_cs: closing communication loop with affected customers.

beth_oncall: incident status -> mitigated. Moving to postmortem phase. :white_check_mark:
